title: Trailing placement
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $l$, the trailing placement of $l$ positions into $k+l$ positions sends each source position to the target position obtained by adding $k$. Its selection map returns the corresponding source position on those last $l$ target positions and is undefined on the first $k$ positions.
